items.summary: Canary Capital's Staked INJ ETF debuts on Nasdaq, giving investors exposure to Injective's INJ token plus staking rewards reflected in NAV.

items.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
items.summary: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

items.title: Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily
items.summary: Keel sold 2,520 bitcoin in the third quarter, left its treasury near zero and said Quebec-mined coins will now be sold every day as it pivots to AI data centers. This post Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
items.summary: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Crashes Over 5% to $75,000 as Tech Rout Wipes Out Leveraged Longs
